chd.label: Campaign history 2017-2026
chd.portal: KP+TD UC spotting workbook (Dropbox, shared by EOC data cell)
chd.note: 134MB workbook; first read streams the DATA sheet into cache/ch_rows.pkl (~3 min), later runs reuse the cache until the workbook mtime changes.

snd.label: Upcoming campaign scope + day-wise targets
snd.portal: Final scope workbook issued for the upcoming campaign (D:\AMAZON DATA\SNID <campaign> folder)
snd.note: When a new campaign scope arrives, edit config.name and config.start here - the tab title, hero chip, countdown popup and Evening Review day dates all follow SND.n / SND.st. Rename the tab labels separately (search the old campaign name across the 4 variants).

icm.label: Intra-campaign monitoring (ICM) UC-wise sheet
icm.portal: EOC dashboard > Intra-campaign monitoring > export UC-wise sheet
icm.note: config.asof = null keeps the as-of date already embedded in the dashboard; set it (YYYY-MM-DD) when a new monitoring round is loaded.

adv.label: ZD reported & covered 2024-2025 (IDIMS advance reports)
adv.portal: IDIMS > zero dose advance report > per-campaign UC export (all campaigns of a year in one file)
adv.note: Every advance_reports_*.xls under the roots is loaded - each file is self-contained, and a campaign present in several exports is taken from the newest file (so dropping a new year's file is enough). Staleness tracks only the newest file. Campaign names without a month/year go in config.campaigns; anything else unknown aborts the extract.

zd.label: ZD Digitization (IDIMS comparison report)
zd.portal: IDIMS / SMC Tracker > Comparison Report export
zd.howto: Drop the newest Comparison_Report_YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx into BOTH D:\AMAZON DATA and C:\Users\HD\Downloads (the legacy pipeline scans Downloads), then rebuild and harvest - see SOURCES.md, 'Harvesting from the legacy pipeline'. DATA needs two reports: the newest one plus the latest one from a DIFFERENT campaign, which supplies the rp/lp comparison columns. Never run zd_refresh.py against this repo - it rebuilds from dashboard_template.html and would drop every tab added after 10-Oct-2026.

zdcov.label: ZD Reported & Covered (multi-campaign coverage workbook)
zdcov.portal: IDIMS > zero dose reported/covered export, one per campaign, saved as _portal\cov_<campaign>.xls in the legacy folder
zdcov.howto: Update D:\AMAZON DATA\ZERO DOSE REPORTED AND COVERED.xlsx and/or drop new cov_<campaign>.xls overlays into C:\Users\HD\Downloads\ZD_Dashboard\_portal, then rebuild and harvest (see SOURCES.md). ZD is NOT produced by the Comparison Report - do not confuse it with the zd entry above.

val.label: ZD Validation (child-level app export)
val.portal: SMC Tracker form 200 > combined export (login required)
val.howto: Save the combined CSV export as C:\Users\HD\Downloads\ZD_Dashboard\_portal\val_<campaign>.csv (move the previous copy into _portal\_prev). Each val_*.csv REPLACES every master row of the campaigns it contains, so keep one file per campaign. Then rebuild and harvest (see SOURCES.md). VCH is the only payload that differs per variant: the internal build carries nm/fn plus real cd/mo, the public build drops nm and fn and blanks cd and mo. Derive the public one from the internal one - never copy either way blindly. Do NOT mirror these CSVs into the repo's own _portal folder: it is published on GitHub Pages and they carry child names, father names, EPI card numbers, monitor names and surveyor emails.

epi.label: Routine EPI coverage (UC YTD + district monthly)
epi.howto: Export the facility-wise report, then rebuild EPI/EPIM/EMETA with _pipeline\_epi_jansep_patch.py in the legacy folder and inject the payloads here.

cq.label: Campaign quality / intra-campaign operational indicators
cq.howto: Export from NEOC into _portal/camp_quality.json, or use the in-dashboard NEOC import block on the Intra-campaign tab (stores to localStorage, never to the repo).

mism.label: Missed children & refusals
mism.portal: EOC dashboard > per-campaign coverage export (login required)
mism.howto: Save one coverage export per campaign as _portal\cov_<campaign>.xls (the .xls is really an HTML table), then rebuild and harvest. Not derived from the val_*.csv validation exports - those feed the val entry.

surv.label: Surveillance (AFP + district surveillance)
surv.howto: Refresh the _portal JSON exports, then rebuild SURVM/AFP.

neoc.label: NEOC operational indicators (AIC visited, teams monitored)
neoc.howto: In-dashboard import only: Intra-campaign tab > NEOC block > paste table / import CSV-TSV-HTML export / run the copied snippet in your own NEOC console. Stored in localStorage['kpNEOC.icm.v1'], never committed. Session cookies are not used by any script here.
